note: Domain taxonomy designed for agent retrieval, not for mirroring API tags. Each domain maps a product area to the UI location a human would use, so an agent can explain where an action lives.

contacts.label: Contacts & audiences
contacts.description: People records, contact attributes, folders, lists, segments, imports/exports, consent groups and custom object records.

crm.label: CRM (companies, deals, tasks, notes)
crm.description: Sales objects: companies, deals, pipelines, tasks, notes, files and their custom attributes.

email_campaigns.label: Email campaigns
email_campaigns.description: Marketing email campaigns: create, edit, test, schedule, send, export recipients and read reports.

sms_campaigns.label: SMS campaigns
sms_campaigns.description: Marketing SMS campaigns: create, schedule, send, test and report.

whatsapp_campaigns.label: WhatsApp campaigns
whatsapp_campaigns.description: Marketing WhatsApp campaigns, templates and template approval.

transactional_email.label: Transactional email
transactional_email.description: Transactional email sending, logs, statistics, blocklists and scheduled-message management.

transactional_sms.label: Transactional SMS
transactional_sms.description: Transactional SMS sending, statistics and templates.

transactional_whatsapp.label: Transactional WhatsApp
transactional_whatsapp.description: Transactional WhatsApp messages and delivery events.

templates.label: Templates
templates.description: Reusable email and SMS templates (transactional and marketing).

senders_and_domains.label: Senders, domains & IPs
senders_and_domains.description: Sender identities, sender-domain authentication (DKIM/DMARC), and dedicated IPs.

webhooks.label: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Webhook configuration and delivery history for Brevo events.

external_feeds.label: External feeds (RSS)
external_feeds.description: External RSS feeds used as content sources for campaigns and automation.

ecommerce.label: eCommerce
ecommerce.description: Products, categories, orders, attribution and eCommerce configuration.

loyalty.label: Loyalty & wallet
loyalty.description: Loyalty programs, tiers, rewards, balances, transactions, subscriptions and wallet passes.

conversations.label: Conversations
conversations.description: Live chat and omnichannel inbox: agent status, messages, pushed messages and visitor routing.

events.label: Events & tracking
events.description: Custom events used for tracking behaviour and triggering automations.

inbound.label: Inbound email parsing
inbound.description: Parsing of received emails and their attachments.

custom_objects.label: Custom objects
custom_objects.description: Custom object schema records and associations.

account_admin.label: Account administration
account_admin.description: Account details, users, invitations, permissions, sub-accounts, plans, IPs and activity logs.

processes.label: Background processes
processes.description: Asynchronous job tracking (imports, exports, batch operations).

marketing_automation.label: Marketing automation
marketing_automation.description: Automation workflows: triggers, steps, delays, conditions, enrollment and logs. Mostly UI-driven; the public API does not expose workflow CRUD.

landing_pages.label: Landing pages
landing_pages.description: Landing page builder: create, edit sections, publish, duplicate, custom domains and sub-pages. No public API.

forms.label: Forms
forms.description: Sign-up, pop-up, unsubscribe and profile-update forms, double opt-in and notifications. No public API.

push_popups.label: Push, pop-ups & in-app
push_popups.description: Web push campaigns, pop-ups and in-app messages. No public API.

ad_studio.label: Ad Studio
ad_studio.description: Static and video ad creation. No public API.

meetings.label: Meetings
meetings.description: Meeting scheduling and booking pages. No public API.

phone.label: Phone
phone.description: Phone numbers, calls and call settings. No public API.

analytics_reports.label: Analytics & reports
analytics_reports.description: Cross-channel dashboards, campaign reports, eCommerce dashboards and exports.

integrations.label: Integrations & plugins
integrations.description: Connecting external systems (WordPress, Shopify, WooCommerce, CRMs) and managing API keys. Mostly UI/account-level.

deliverability.label: Deliverability
deliverability.description: Sender reputation, domain authentication, blocklists and deliverability tooling.
